profile.name: Arjun Subramanya
profile.headline: Salesforce developer and administrator building systems that operations teams rely on.
profile.summary: I build and support Salesforce systems for operations teams: Flow automation, custom objects, permissions and reporting, plus Apex and Lightning components when configuration is not enough. I also work in Python, SQL and Swift.

experience.title: Business Systems Developer & Administrator
experience.body: I manage the Salesforce platform for a Waterloo Region organization. The role covers daily administration, Flow automation and custom objects, reporting for program directors and the executive board, user support and training, and Apex and Lightning work where custom behavior is needed.

experience.title: Junior Software Engineer & CRM Analyst
experience.body: Built Apex and REST integrations, migrated and de-duplicated large data sets, and produced Tableau dashboards for executive KPI reporting.

education: Post-Graduate Diploma, Sport Business Management — Durham College
Bachelor of Engineering, Computer Science — MS Ramaiah Institute of Technology

projects.name: Northgate Motors
projects.tagline: A fictional dealership, built end to end on Salesforce.
projects.summary: A six-page Experience Cloud buyer site with a WebGL concept-car studio, backed by the sales, finance and service operations of a fictional dealership.

projects.name: Vantage
projects.tagline: Tennis scoring, tournaments and stats for iPhone and Apple Watch.
projects.summary: A native iOS and watchOS app for playing and tracking tennis, with live scoring, knockout and round-robin tournaments, Glicko-2 ratings, Watch workouts and Live Activities.

projects.name: Nova Grants
projects.tagline: Grant intake, claim adjudication and funding oversight in Salesforce.
projects.summary: An independent, fictional Salesforce demonstration of the grant lifecycle: applicant intake, eligibility review, verified claims, reimbursement and executive reporting.

projects.name: Care Operations Analytics
projects.tagline: A funding, operations and risk dashboard for a fictional care provider.
projects.summary: A Python analytics pipeline and dashboard built on synthetic Canadian care data, from data-quality checks and a PostgreSQL-ready schema to Streamlit, Power BI and Tableau views.

projects.name: Gotcare Care Ledger
projects.tagline: A Salesforce funding ledger with auditable claim approvals.
projects.summary: A prototype for person-directed care funding: care plans, allocations, claims and ledger entries, with atomic Apex approvals and a balance alert that fires when funding crosses a threshold.

projects.name: Configurable RevOps Platform
projects.tagline: Deal-desk discount intake with metadata-driven pricing rules.
projects.summary: A Salesforce prototype for a configurable enterprise deal desk: discount intake, metadata-driven pricing and approval rules, and a queue-owned Deal Review record.

projects.name: Tennis Lesson Planner API
projects.tagline: A small FastAPI service that turns player goals into structured lesson plans.
projects.summary: Rule-based lesson-plan generation with FastAPI, Pydantic validation, SQLite storage and automated API tests, ready to run with Docker.

projects.name: Agentic Job Search Workflow
projects.tagline: A privacy-first, local-only CLI for a disciplined job search.
projects.summary: Lane coverage, local posting checks, document-quality audits and CSV tracking, with dry-run defaults, explicit confirmation and dated backups before any write.
